domains.label: Career
domains.means: Depth of the professional job market: large employers, finance, corporate headquarters.
domains.from: Kearney GCI rank and GFCI rank (averaged when both exist): 99.4 − 4.59·ln(GCI rank); 99.5 − 4.43·ln(GFCI rank). Agreement with the US hand scores: r = 0.82 / 0.88.

domains.label: Entrepreneurship
domains.means: How good a place it is to start and fund a company.

domains.label: Tech
domains.means: Size and strength of the tech sector and its talent.
domains.from: StartupBlink rank (99.6 − 6.49·ln(rank), r = 0.89), averaged with Startup Genome Top-40 rank (94.9 − 4.49·ln(rank), r = 0.66) where ranked.

domains.label: Network
domains.means: Global connectedness: who comes through, what gets decided there.

domains.label: Lifestyle
domains.means: Day-to-day quality of life: safety, health care, climate, pollution, commute.
domains.from: Numbeo Quality of Life, rescaled onto the US hand scores' spread: 76.2 + (QoL − 173.3) ÷ 16.4 × 5.9. Weak agreement with the hand scores (r = 0.25), so read these with care.

METHOD.fit: How the formulas were set: each index was compared with the 30 hand-set US scores, and a straight line was fitted between them (ranks on a log scale, because the gap between #1 and #10 matters more than the gap between #100 and #110). Those lines score the international cities, which puts both sets on one scale. As a check, rescoring the US cities with the same formulas lands within 2.7 (career), 3.8 (entrepreneurship), 3.3 (tech), 3.5 (network) and 5.5 (lifestyle) points of the hand scores on average. Scores are clamped to 35–99. Cost/day = 2.5 × Numbeo Cost of Living Plus Rent, rounded to $5; the US hand estimates run about 2.5× that index too (r = 0.95).
METHOD.tier: Tier rule: expansion if the universal score is 81 or higher, otherwise base. That line separates the 30 hand-set US cities exactly (every US expansion city is 81.6 or higher, every base city 80.8 or lower), so it is applied to the international cities unchanged. Lagos has no usable Numbeo Quality of Life figure (the table shows 0.0), so its lifestyle is left blank and its averages use the four domains it has.
